maddeler.e:
نتماثل (form VI)
# نَتَمَاثَلُ (natamāṯalu) /na.ta.maː.θa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَاثَلَ (tamāṯala)
# نَتَمَاثَلَ (natamāṯala) /na.ta.maː.θa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاثَلَ (tamāṯala)
# نَتَمَاثَلْ (natamāṯal) /na.ta.maː.θal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَاثَلَ (tamāṯala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
